description: This file contains a class 'SiloMessagingOptionsValidator' that implements validation logic for 'SiloMessagingOptions' configuration settings within the Orleans project. It primarily validates the 'MaxForwardCount' property to ensure it does not exceed 255.

classes.name: SiloMessagingOptionsValidator
classes.description: A validator class for 'SiloMessagingOptions' used to enforce constraints on configuration values.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the provided 'SiloMessagingOptions' instance, specifically checking that 'MaxForwardCount' does not exceed 255.
